sections.title: Salary standards overview
sections.content:
## Purpose

Salary standards are used to declare the salary rate for each transport route. The rate can differ by area, order type, container size and customer.

## Access

**Menu:** Driver salary > Configuration > Salary standards

![](/uploads/7bb06b4ad46f328c92725798.png)

sections.title: Creating a salary standard
sections.content:
### Step 1

Click **New**.

![](/uploads/ff1c1e91d398b87f127791ff.png)

### Step 2

Enter the general information, and the conditions for the customer and the route.

![](/uploads/3951706c2d32c835ed62dcd8.png)

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Item | Salary item that applies. |
| Effective date | Date the standard starts applying; you can also declare an end date. |
| Value | The salary rate. |
| Company | Company the standard applies to. |
| Customer | Customer the standard applies to specifically, if any. |
| Order type | Order type it applies to, such as Export container, Import container or Warehouse transfer. |
| Container size | Container size it applies to, such as 20ft, 40ft or Bulk cargo. |
| Route group | Transport route it applies to. |
| From location / To location | Location range of the route it applies to. |

### Step 3

Click **Save manually** to save the standard.

![](/uploads/0bc6bcb1273bdcf6a17772dd.png)

sections.title: Editing a salary standard
sections.content:
### Step 1

Select the standard you want to edit from the list.

![](/uploads/3a4ff552f5af880cf20580db.png)

### Step 2

Change the information you need, then click **Save manually**.

![](/uploads/c86fae23df90c215290a8bd4.png)

sections.title: Deleting a salary standard
sections.content:
### Step 1

Select the record you want to delete.

![](/uploads/8a50ba8d168348150a52ab3a.png)

### Step 2

Select **Actions** > **Delete**.

![](/uploads/6a0262611d95177be123e150.png)

### Step 3

Confirm with the **Delete** button. This removes the record permanently.

![](/uploads/d6a26dd042553a0c8cdb63cd.png)
